name: r1bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean shapes, lots of calm white space. Unbranded, no text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A quiet town street seen from the side with NO vehicles and NO people: on the left a red brick fire station with two big closed garage doors and a small bell tower, on the right a tall cream coloured apartment building with many square windows, a few small green trees and a lamp post between them, a grey sidewalk, and a light grey paved road strip across the whole bottom third of the picture. The upper part of the picture is plain white paper (no sky colour).
